notes: v282 — LOADS-SITE-PEGS (Oct 29, 2026, owner feedback 14:07 MDT). The owner: the time/dwell GPS load counter can never be accurate where pickup and dump are the same place; the user must be able to PEG the pickup site and the dump site, and re-peg them as the day changes. BUILD: (1) Tracker (js/app.js + css/style.css) — under the +1/-1 correction pair, two big distinct one-tap buttons, PEG PICKUP (blue) and PEG DUMP (purple), each planting a peg at the phone current GPS position, plus a state line showing each peg by TIME only (Pickup pegged 2:14 PM / Dump not pegged) — coordinates are never displayed or typed anywhere. A refused tap (no live fix yet / fix too rough) alerts plainly. (2) Engine (js/geoloads.js) — new createPegCounter: the standard armed alternation at intra-site grade (30 m fence, 30 m accuracy bar) with a 30 s declared-place dwell, fed a 4-fix rolling centroid so stopped-truck GPS scatter cannot accumulate dwell on the wrong peg; two pegs ~15 m apart inside one site separate by peg identity + visit sequence. (3) Glue — pegs live on the day record (rec.pegs + rec.pegLog of every set/re-peg); GeoLoads.setPeg flushes the running count, writes the peg, and configure() arms the peg counter AHEAD of every inference source (learners do not run on a peg day); a moved peg re-arms fresh with the day banked count carried as base — counted loads are never erased or recounted, past days never rewritten. Peg-keyed days are marked countSource pegs on the record and surface via forDate()/today() (the tracker count line reads counted from your pegs). No-peg days run the inference stack byte-for-byte as before. HARNESS: NEW tools/loads-site-pegs-v282-test.js 26/26 (RED pre-fix: setPeg/pegs absent) — (a) two-site pegs count from the first cycle, (a2) API surface + honest no-fix refusal, (b) same-place pegs ~15 m apart count 3 cycles, (c) mid-day re-peg: banked count survives, move logged, cycles count from the new peg, (d) no-peg teach day unchanged. REGRESSIONS A/B vs pristine v281: geoloads family at standing baselines (geofence 58/58, learning 32/32, v267 19/19, v268 16/16, v140 38/38), batch-v220 36/36, dispatch-shiftclose 46/46, manual-start-law 33/33, manifest gps-data-v275 31/31 + home-stops 14/14, live-drive 69/69, signin-lock 92/92; drive-surface-v227 27/4, widget-load-words-v244 6/2, back-button 71/1, manifest-toggles 47/49, fix-batch-v224 48/1 and the pip-bubble-v231 / loads-gps-fix-v203 crashes are IDENTICAL on the pristine tree (stale pins / sibling-path environment artifacts, not deltas). PIN MOVES: index.html style.css 280 -> 282, app.js 279 -> 282, geoloads.js 268 -> 282. NAMED MINIMAL CHOICES: peg = the counter own last live fix (gated at the counter 50 m accuracy bar); peg dwell 30 s (declared ground truth, not a guessed place); pegs arm counting even on a dispatch-less day (the tap is the authority); no un-peg control (re-peg is the adjustment; pegs die with the day); a re-peg restarts the cycle state (a load already on the truck at re-peg time is the +1 buttons job). VERDICT OWED IN HIS HANDS: on the next same-place job, peg pickup + dump at the two spots and watch the loads count themselves; change sites mid-day, re-peg, and watch the count follow.
